accounts_crypto_provider_iff_exchange.name: accounts_crypto_provider_iff_exchange
accounts_crypto_provider_iff_exchange.value: ("accounts"."crypto_source" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'exchange') = ("accounts"."crypto_provider" IS NOT NULL)

accounts_crypto_sync_only_crypto.name: accounts_crypto_sync_only_crypto
accounts_crypto_sync_only_crypto.value: "accounts"."type" = 'crypto' or ("accounts"."crypto_synced_at" is null and "accounts"."crypto_sync_failed_at" is null)

transactions_correction_only_on_bank_row.name: transactions_correction_only_on_bank_rows
transactions_correction_only_on_bank_row.value: not "transactions"."manual" or ("transactions"."original_amount_cents" is null and "transactions"."original_booking_date" is null)

recurring_items_share_complete.name: recurring_items_share_complete
recurring_items_share_complete.value: ("recurring_items"."share_contact_id" is null and "recurring_items"."share_bps" is null and "recurring_items"."share_amount_cents" is null and "recurring_items"."share_from" is null) or ("recurring_items"."share_contact_id" is not null and "recurring_items"."share_from" is not null and (("recurring_items"."share_bps" is null) <> ("recurring_items"."share_amount_cents" is null)))

recurring_items_share_range.name: recurring_items_share_range
recurring_items_share_range.value: ("recurring_items"."share_bps" is null or ("recurring_items"."share_bps" >= 1 and "recurring_items"."share_bps" <= 10000)) and ("recurring_items"."share_amount_cents" is null or "recurring_items"."share_amount_cents" > 0)

crypto_wallet_tokens_contract_complete.name: crypto_wallet_tokens_contract_complete
crypto_wallet_tokens_contract_complete.value: ("crypto_wallet_tokens"."chain" is null) = ("crypto_wallet_tokens"."contract" is null) and ("crypto_wallet_tokens"."contract" is null) = ("crypto_wallet_tokens"."decimals" is null)

crypto_movements_tx_hash_digest.name: crypto_movements_tx_hash_digest
crypto_movements_tx_hash_digest.value: "crypto_movements"."tx_hash_digest" IS NULL OR ("crypto_movements"."import_id" IS NOT NULL AND "crypto_movements"."tx_hash_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

crypto_movements_observed_shape.name: crypto_movements_observed_shape
crypto_movements_observed_shape.value: ("crypto_movements"."kind" IN ('observed_in', 'observed_out')) = ("crypto_movements"."import_id" IS NULL) AND ("crypto_movements"."kind" IN ('observed_in', 'observed_out')) = ("crypto_movements"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("crypto_movements"."observed_since" IS NULL OR "crypto_movements"."kind" IN ('observed_in', 'observed_out'))

crypto_movements_resolution_kind.name: crypto_movements_resolution_kind
crypto_movements_resolution_kind.value: "crypto_movements"."resolution" IS NULL OR ("crypto_movements"."resolution" IN ('bought', 'gift') AND "crypto_movements"."kind" IN ('deposit', 'observed_in')) OR ("crypto_movements"."resolution" = 'disposed' AND "crypto_movements"."kind" IN ('withdrawal', 'observed_out'))

crypto_movements_given_cost.name: crypto_movements_given_cost
crypto_movements_given_cost.value: ("crypto_movements"."cost_cents" IS NOT NULL) = COALESCE("crypto_movements"."resolution" IN ('bought', 'gift'), false) AND ("crypto_movements"."resolution" IS DISTINCT FROM 'gift' OR "crypto_movements"."cost_cents" = 0) AND ("crypto_movements"."cost_cents" IS NULL OR "crypto_movements"."cost_cents" >= 0)

receivable_payments_split_needs_transact.name: receivable_payments_split_needs_transaction
receivable_payments_split_needs_transact.value: "receivable_payments"."split_id" is null or "receivable_payments"."transaction_id" is not null

public.transaction_lines.definition: select t.id, s.id as split_id, t.account_id, t.import_id, t.booking_date, ((case when s.id is null then t.amount_cents else s.amount_cents end) + coalesce(ra.adjust_cents, 0) + (case when (case when s.id is null then t.amount_cents else s.amount_cents end) < 0 then 1 else -1 end) * coalesce(pa.settled_cents, 0))::bigint as amount_cents, case when s.id is null then t.amount_cents else s.amount_cents end as gross_amount_cents, t.raw_label, t.merchant, coalesce(lc.kind, t.kind) as kind, coalesce(s.category_id, t.category_id) as category_id, t.needs_review, (t.is_one_off or t.prepaid_item_id is not null) as is_one_off, t.manual, t.prepaid_item_id, t.paid_by_contact_id from transactions t left join transaction_splits s on s.transaction_id = t.id left join categories lc on lc.id = coalesce(s.category_id, t.category_id) left join (select r.transaction_id, r.split_id, sum(case when r.direction = 'owed_to_me' then r.amount_cents - r.forgiven_cents else r.forgiven_cents end) as adjust_cents from receivables r group by r.transaction_id, r.split_id) ra on ra.transaction_id = t.id and coalesce(ra.split_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) = coalesce(s.id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) left join (select transaction_id, split_id, sum(amount_cents) as settled_cents from receivable_payments where transaction_id is not null group by transaction_id, split_id) pa on pa.transaction_id = t.id and coalesce(pa.split_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) = coalesce(s.id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
public.transaction_lines.name: transaction_lines
